cases.title: After a pipe is placed with inverts 18.240 and 18.190, the next New Pipe window offers 'Use recent invert' buttons for both, newest first, before any older level
cases.plan_item: UX-PIPE-04 recent values as buttons, the recent-invert part (daily card D05; part only)
cases.expected: CD from 150000,-90000 to 160000,-90000 with inverts 18.240 / 18.190 and Start Pipe places one pipe ('[CE] Pipe placed.'). A second CD from 150000,-92000 to 160000,-92000 opens New Pipe, whose Levels & Flow tab shows a button 'Use recent invert 18.190 m AHD' as the FIRST recent invert button and 'Use recent invert 18.240 m AHD' after it. Cancel without saving closes it (the object count is recorded).
cases.why_not_unit: The buttons are built in the installed window from the remembered list that the real Start Pipe just wrote.
not_automated: Card D05 assertion 1 (diameter and material buttons equal the remembered lists) and assertion 2 (a press fills the box and the label) are NOT driven: the buttons are on a tab the robot cannot open and pressing them is not on the press list. Assertion 3 is a picture item.
